_comment: Renderer validation scenarios for tools/run-renderer-scenario.ps1 (read by tests/test_renderer_scenarios.py).
input: the scripted-pad file. seed: tools/make-edf-save.py arguments, or null for a fresh profile (Mission 1).
mission: the id renderer-runtime-gate.py --expect-mission checks (MISSION.CAM lookup).
capture_start: indexed output frame (3D frames since the first scene draw, pre-mission scene included) where
A/B captures begin; estimated, see each input file. seconds: how long each variant runs before it is stopped.

benchmark.description: Mission 1 (M202, Map01 City 1) from a fresh profile, standing fire down the street: the existing benchmark route

benchmark-skipintro.description: The benchmark route (M202, Map01 City 1, fresh profile) with the Mission 1 intro skipped by one Start press at 85 s of game time: compares the street load (loading2) against the benchmark's, where the intro plays through; capture_start is the benchmark's less the ~2600 skipped intro frames

cave.description: Mission 11 Infiltration (M301, Map08 Cave 2): underground nest, 110 ants at close range

ufo-swarm.description: Mission 6 Airforce (M212, Map02 City 2): the mothership's gunship swarm filling the sky

vehicle.description: Mission 9 Tsugawa (M211, Map05 Mountains): enter the tank at the spawn, drive and fire among Walking Arms

soak.description: Mission 1 Arrival (M202) through the seeded route with 1200200 stamina: 30 minutes of gameplay

ab.description: locked frame rate, guest and native frames alternating every frame, 64 consecutive output captures from capture_start

unlocked.description: native renderer, unlocked at a 120 FPS cap without vsync, frame times and GPU pass timings

soak-ab.description: A/B every frame for the whole soak; one output capture every 701 frames (odd, so captures alternate guest/native), 128 captures = 89,000 frames, about 25 minutes at 60 FPS; memory log and frame times on

soak-unlocked.description: native renderer unlocked at 120 FPS for the whole soak with frame times, GPU timings and the memory log: the soak-report.py input
